title: Widget: the guest token renews, a visitor is made on first write with per-address limits and idle eviction, each anonymous visitor speaks under its own identity
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run the run.cmd below (node --test over the widget, relay, say and cron suites; database cases skip without TEST_DATABASE_URL).
S2: Read the exit code and the pass/fail counts.
expect: The internal guest session is minted again after SESSION_RENEW_AFTER_S or within 5 minutes of its end, once for concurrent calls; a process 72 h old still answers anonymous calls.

GET /widget/api/state without a cookie sets no cookie and keeps no visitor; the first write makes one; the 21st new visitor from one address in an hour answers 429 WIDGET_VISITOR_LIMIT; a full map drops the idle anonymous visitor used longest ago, and with every visitor busy answers 503 WIDGET_AT_CAPACITY with Retry-After 30.

Two anonymous visitors speak under two widget-guest+<hmac16>@widget.invalid identities: one's microphone never ends the other's session, each has its own day, and the widget-anonymous bucket stops them all at its own limit.
The cron job deletes expired widget_conversation rows in batches.
evidence: Review of #1425/#1426 on 18/10/2026: the guest token was minted once per process (sessions live 72 h; prod ran ~39 h between deploys), every page load wrote a visitor row, and all anonymous visitors shared one speech quota and one live session. Council 19/10/2026.
fence: The widget door's visitor lifecycle, the internal sessions and the speech identity, through the door tests. Not exercised: a real speech service, a customer's site embedding the widget, Cloudflare's address header.
